column1: # Outpatient care made up 46% of gross patient revenue at the median hospital in FY2024, up from 37% in FY2014.

# Source: Median of general-acute hospitals with data each year (262 in FY2014, 265 in FY2024), so the set of hospitals changes a little from year to year. The Center's brief uses a fixed set of 248 hospitals and aggregate revenue, so its figures differ. HCAI annual disclosure data, computed on this site. *FY2024 is preliminary.
